message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest of the city’s greenmarkets, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market is open every Saturday, Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. (and on Wednesdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) and offers a wide variety of fresh produce, meats, cheeses, baked goods, and prepared foods from local farmers and artisans. Its central location at Union Square and its reputation for quality and variety make it the top destination for both locals and tourists looking to shop for fresh, locally sourced food.
